globalStyle: SNES 16-bit pixel art combat effect animation, limited color palette, chunky clean pixels, retro tactical RPG visual effect, glowing energy on a solid pure black background

combat_fx.stylePrefix: sprite sheet of exactly 4 animation frames arranged in a 2x2 grid, each frame centered in its quadrant, frames read left-to-right top-to-bottom showing the effect appear, peak, and dissipate, solid pure black background, no grid lines, no borders, no text

assets.name: fx_pierce
assets.prompt: armor-shattering pierce impact, ice-blue and white jagged crack lines bursting from a center point with sharp metallic shard fragments flying outward

assets.name: fx_drain
assets.prompt: life drain effect, deep crimson energy wisps spiraling inward toward center transforming into small green healing motes rising, vampiric essence flow

assets.name: fx_shield
assets.prompt: defensive barrier flash, translucent blue hexagonal energy shield dome appearing at center with a bright white rim glint deflecting a blow, small sparks at the impact point

assets.name: fx_flurry
assets.prompt: blade flurry effect, five thin overlapping white and cyan slash streaks crossing at sharp angles in a star pattern with tiny motion spark trails

assets.name: fx_buff
assets.prompt: power-up aura effect, warm golden-yellow sparkles and thin upward-streaming light ribbons rising from the bottom around a center point

assets.name: fx_status
assets.prompt: ailment affliction effect, sickly purple and murky green noxious swirl with small rising bubbles and drooping wisp tendrils at center

assets.name: fx_ring
assets.prompt: expanding circular shockwave ring, pure white and pale gray glowing energy ring bursting outward from center, thin clean circle outline growing larger each frame, strictly monochrome white on black
